correctness.rationale: For stationary uniform ring position and independent symmetric telegraph sign, the Fourier-mode generator Q_n has diagonal -Dq_n^2-alpha±ivq_n and off-diagonal alpha. Integrating its semigroup gives (Dq_n²+2alpha)/(q_n²(v²+D²q_n²+2Dalpha)). Mean-zero L2 forcing and Brownian spectral gap justify Parseval sum and Green–Kubo limit. Subtracting from the alpha→infinity value gives v²/D Σ P_n/[q_n²(B_n+2Dalpha)]; strict alternating derivative signs for nonzero force follow termwise. The poles at alpha=-B_n/(2D) are distinct, residues identify all P_n from ideal open-interval scans; phase information is unrecoverable. If harmonics stop at known N, differences of N+1 distinct readings eliminate unknown D0 and form invertible Cauchy system; with <=N readings linear nullspace perturbations around strictly positive spectra show sharp nonidentifiability. Independently checked the generator inverse, derivative and deficit identities symbolically and an exact-rational six-harmonic Cauchy reconstruction. Infinite-series continuation is justified analytically, not by those finite tests. Scope excludes coupled feedback, unknown L,D,v and noisy inversion.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks alone are not an all-size theorem; the unrestricted proof and normalization were read in RESULT.md.
